components.name: Domain navigation
components.description: Compact dark navigation with visible selection.
components.css: .ds-nav{background:var(--os-nav,#192a32);padding:8px;display:flex;gap:3px}.ds-nav button{font:400 12px var(--os-font,sans-serif);padding:9px 14px;color:#c4d0d7;border:1px solid transparent;background:none;border-radius:5px}.ds-nav button:hover{background:#ffffff0c;color:#fff}.ds-nav .ds-selected{background:#ffffff13;border-color:#ffffff1c;box-shadow:inset 0 -2px var(--os-purple,#7753a7);color:#fff}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#7753a7);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Weekly day count
components.description: Interactive weekly matrix cell with tasks.
components.css: .ds-count{display:grid;place-content:center;gap:1px;min-height:40px;margin:6px 3px;padding:0 8px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--os-purple,#7753a7) 14%,white);border-radius:4px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--os-purple,#7753a7) 9%,white);color:var(--os-purple,#7753a7);font-family:var(--os-font,sans-serif);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-count b{font-size:16px;line-height:1.2}.ds-count span{font-size:10px}.ds-count:hover{border-color:var(--os-purple,#7753a7)}.ds-count:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#7753a7);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: High density productivity UI with compact titles, quiet working surfaces and source evidence. This describes the shared CSS layer, including inherited legacy limits.
keyCharacteristics: Purple, jade, bronze and indigo accents
Thin separators and bounded dense-view overflow

rules.name: Immutable identity and product contracts
rules.body: Preserve orbital logo bytes and every domain, menu item, route, permission and source record.

dos: Use the existing domain accent and shared focus treatment.
Keep evidence, caveats and completion semantics intact.
Inspect inherited module styles before claiming normalization.
donts: Do not add slogans, oversized headings or display serif typography.
Do not invent revenue, completion percentages or evidence.
Do not replace or redraw the original orbital logo.
